## Profile

- Name: Yugesh Reddy Sappidi

## Summary

Yugesh is an AI Engineer working at the intersection of two questions: how to
break an AI system, and how to make it unbreakable. He builds production-grade
ML research systems around retrieval-augmented generation, context engineering,
red teaming, fine-tuning (SFT/DPO), and test-time adaptation, with an emphasis
on making models robust across languages — treated as both a safety and a
fairness problem. His recent work probes where modern LLMs and vision-language
models fail under adversarial pressure, then designs adaptive defenses that
learn and improve rather than relying on static guardrails.

## Experience

- Graduate Research Assistant — University of Illinois Health (UI Health),
  Chicago, IL (Oct 2025 – May 2026). Designed RAG pipelines over clinical
  datasets (FastAPI + GPT-4 + Pinecone) grounding LLM outputs in source
  documents to reduce hallucination; optimized retrieval for low-connectivity
  (1.2s median latency); integrated Twilio + Cloudflare D1/KV for concurrent
  WhatsApp sessions; containerized with Docker and orchestrated on Kubernetes
  (Helm), cutting response failures by 60%.
- Web Development & Design Intern — Grohubz, Hyderabad, IN (Jun 2023 – Aug 2023).
  Built responsive React.js UIs for an Instagram DM automation platform; state
  management with React Hooks and Redux; Docker Compose orchestration; 95% test
  coverage with Mocha.
